prompts.title: 现代户外咖啡馆的随性生活肖像
prompts.description: 一个高度详细的提示，用于生成一张女性在黄金时段自然地坐在现代欧式户外咖啡馆的自发垂直生活方式肖像，重点突出自然曲线、柔和光线和高端摄影规格，以实现真实、不做作的效果。
prompts.content:
A strikingly beautiful and always recognizable woman, captured naturally sitting on the terrace of a modern outdoor café. Long brown hair that falls naturally over her shoulders with a soft movement. A distant and gentle gaze, looking slightly to one side, relaxed and thoughtful, unaware of the camera. Natural feminine curves with a defined waist and realistic hips. She is wearing a fitted, fine-knit, sleeveless top in a warm sand tone, combined with a short, straight, structured, high-waisted skirt that accentuates the waist and hips. Elegant, minimalist, pointed-toe nude heels. Urban lifestyle, refined and without effort.
Sitting sideways on a café chair, legs naturally positioned and torso slightly angled, one elbow casually resting on the table, shoulders relaxed and asymmetrical, an organic and spontaneous posture. Modern European-style outdoor café terrace, wooden table, subtle urban background blur, clean urban textures, warm ambiance, a coffee cup on the table and a mobile phone beside it. Soft golden sunset light. Natural golden hour ambient light, soft, warm lighting that enhances natural curves without exaggerating them.
Shot on professional full-frame mirrorless camera, 85mm f/1.4 lens, f/2.0, ISO 100, 1/1250 s, sharp focus on the subject with separation from the creamy background. Spontaneous vertical lifestyle portrait, slightly sideways perspective as if in a discreet capture, natural calibration of warm daylight. High-end spontaneous lifestyle photography, calm, confident, naturally magnetic. Realistic skin texture with a subtle cinematic warmth.
Avoid direct eye contact, intentional poses, overly dramatic posture, fashion campaign stiffness, exaggerated anatomy, plastic skin effect. Aspect ratio 9:16.

一位引人注目、辨识度极高的女性，自然地坐在现代户外咖啡馆的露台上，被镜头捕捉下来。她留着一头棕色长发，自然地垂落在肩上，带着柔和的动感。眼神遥远而温柔，略微望向一侧，放松而沉思，似乎没有察觉到镜头。她拥有自然的女性曲线，腰部线条分明，臀部真实。她穿着一件合身的细针织无袖上衣，颜色是温暖的沙色，搭配一条短款、直筒、有型的、高腰半身裙，凸显了腰部和臀部线条。脚上是一双优雅、简约、尖头裸色高跟鞋。整体展现出都市生活、精致而不费力的风格。

她侧身坐在咖啡馆的椅子上，双腿自然摆放，身体略微倾斜，一只手肘随意地搭在桌上，双肩放松且不对称，姿态自然而随意。背景是现代欧式户外咖啡馆露台，木质桌子，微妙的都市背景虚化，干净的城市纹理，温暖的氛围，桌上放着一个咖啡杯和一部手机。柔和的金色夕阳余晖。自然黄金时段的环境光，柔和温暖的灯光，在不夸张的情况下突出了自然的曲线。

使用专业全画幅无反相机拍摄，85mm f/1.4 镜头，f/2.0 光圈，ISO 100，快门速度 1/1250 秒，主体对焦清晰，与奶油般虚化的背景分离。自发的垂直生活方式肖像，略微侧向的视角，仿佛是无意间的捕捉，暖日光线的自然校准。高端自发生活方式摄影，平静、自信、自然迷人。真实的皮肤纹理，带有微妙的电影感暖色调。

prompts.title: 电影人像提示词与身份锁定
prompts.description: 一个针对 Google Gemini Nano Banana Pro 的提示，要求生成一张垂直、超写实的电影感女性肖像，置于柔和照明的门廊中，强调身份锁定、自然皮肤纹理和宁静的、具有编辑风格的氛围。
prompts.content:
Create a vertical 9:16 ultra-high-definition, hyper-realistic cinematic portrait. Maintain the exact same facial features and body proportions as the reference image.
Capture a refined lifestyle scene of a woman with thick, flowing dark waves cascading over her shoulders, positioned in a softly illuminated doorway filled with warm natural sunlight. She is styled in a muted sage-toned textured sleeveless top, paired with coordinating smooth satin home shorts that create a relaxed yet elegant aesthetic.
Her pose feels effortless and intimate — one hand gently lifting through her hair, eyes delicately closed as sunlight enhances the authentic skin texture and natural complexion. The overall mood should feel airy, serene, and editorial, with crisp detail, soft shadows, and a realistic depth of field
prompts.translatedContent:
创作一张 9:16 竖版超高清、超写实的电影感肖像。保持与参考图像完全相同的面部特征和身体比例。

捕捉一位女性精致的生活场景：她一头浓密、飘逸的深色波浪发垂在肩上，置身于柔和光线下的门廊中，温暖的自然阳光洒满其间。她身着一件柔和鼠尾草色调的纹理无袖上衣，搭配同色系的顺滑缎面家居短裤，营造出一种轻松而优雅的美感。

她的姿态显得毫不费力且亲密——一只手轻轻撩过头发，双眼微闭，阳光映衬出真实的皮肤纹理和自然肤色。整体氛围应是轻盈、宁静且具有时尚杂志感的，细节清晰，阴影柔和，景深真实。

prompts.title: Jennie Kim 粉色春日肖像
prompts.description: 为 Gemini Nano Banana Pro 提供一个详细的提示，用于生成一张 Jennie Kim (BLACKPINK) 的 8K 单反肖像照。照片应呈现柔和、浪漫、忧郁的春日氛围，并以一件粉色漆皮风衣和樱花为特色。
prompts.content: 8K DSLR portrait shot on 85mm f/1.4 with overcast diffused natural light. Rule of thirds composition, eye-level straight on angle, medium shot waist-up in a 9:16 vertical frame. The subject is {argument name="subject" default="Jennie Kim"}, a young Korean woman, approximately 28 years old, with long dark hair styled in loose waves. She has fair skin and is wearing light makeup. Her facial expression is serene and slightly melancholic. She is sitting on a black metal park bench with her legs crossed at the ankles. She is holding a bouquet of pink flowers in her lap. Her body is angled slightly towards the camera, and her head is turned to face the viewer. She is wearing a pink patent leather trench coat with a matching belt, and pink leather ankle boots with a block heel and lace-up closure. In her lap she holds a bouquet of pink flowers. The background is a city street with pink cherry blossom trees in full bloom. The ground is wet and covered in fallen petals. There is a pink car parked in the background and a black lamppost. The dominant color palette is pink with accents of black and silver. The overall tone is soft and romantic. The mood is dreamy and romantic, with a touch of melancholy, evoking a sense of springtime and feminine beauty. The wet pavement reflects the lights and blossoms, the glossy leather coat shines subtly, and the soft petals create a delicate texture.
